dct_creator_sm: Land Title and Survey Authority of BC.
dct_description_sm: Georeferenced tif of Metchosin District map on the coast of Vancouver Island bordered by the Esquimalt and Sooke Districts. Has sketches and relief shading to show land cover and land forms. There are numbered plots of land that correspond to a narrow table with more information about them. Named places and features include Parry Bay, William Head, Pedder Bay, Cape Calver, Bentinck Island, Christopher Point, Cape Church, Beecher Bay, Frazer Island, Smyth Head, Matheson Lake, Mount Matheson, Pedder Inlet, Montreuls Hill, Mount Blinkhorn, Lake Blinkhorn, Mount Helmeken, Mount Metchosin, Triangular Mountain, and Single Hill.
